role: Generates (or with --check verifies) sbom.spdx.json, an SPDX 2.3 document derived from Package.resolved; run by make sbom-check, ci.yml 'SBOM is current', gates.yml, and planted by verify_gates_fail 'sbom_drift'.
toplevel: Constants: DIRECT={polar-ble-sdk, whisperkit}; LICENSES map for all 11 current identities (unknown identities get NOASSERTION); COPYRIGHTS for polar; POLAR_LICENSE LicenseRef. Docstring says check_sbom_drift.sh verifies the SBOM is not stale, but check_sbom_drift.sh never reads sbom.spdx.json; staleness is checked by this script's own --check. creationInfo.created is a fixed '2026-08-27T00:00:00Z' while the comment says 'No timestamp'. Verified at 8d32097: --check reports 'matches Package.resolved. 11 packages.'

flags.text: Docstring claims `check_sbom_drift.sh` can verify the SBOM has not gone stale; that script only compares Package.resolved with the in-app acknowledgements and never opens sbom.spdx.json.

units.does: Returns 'SPDXRef-Package-' + identity with every char that is not alphanumeric, '.' or '-' replaced by '-'.
Builds a purl: pkg:github/<owner/repo lowercased>@<version or revision> for github https locations (trailing .git removed), else pkg:generic/<identity>@<version>.

Loads Package.resolved, sorts pins by identity, emits the root Emuqu package (PolyForm-Strict-1.0.0) plus one package per pin (version or first 12 chars of revision, licence, purl, SHA1 checksum when revision is 40 chars, direct/transitive comment) and relationships, with documentNamespace derived from sha256 of the lockfile.

branches.effect: relationship Emuqu DEPENDS_ON pkg and 'Direct dependency' comment; else Emuqu DEPENDENCY_OF pkg and 'Transitive' comment

flags.text: For transitive pins the relationship is written as `SPDXRef-Package-Emuqu DEPENDENCY_OF <pkg>`, which in SPDX means Emuqu is a dependency of that package — the direction is inverted, so SCA tools reading the graph get Emuqu as a dependency of swift-protobuf, zip, etc.

The SPDX package `checksums` entry is the 40-char git commit id labelled as SHA1 of the package; SPDX PackageChecksum is a hash of the package content, so a consumer verifying the checksum against the downloaded package always gets a mismatch.

Every transitive pin is related directly to the Emuqu root; the parent (polar-ble-sdk for swift-protobuf/zip, whisperkit for the rest, per the comment at 32-35) is never recorded, so the SBOM graph cannot show which direct dependency pulls each transitive one.

units.does: CLI: serialises build() as indented JSON; --check returns 1 if sbom.spdx.json is missing or differs, else prints match; otherwise writes the file.
units.entry: `python3 scripts/generate_sbom.py [--check]` via __main__ (Makefile sbom/sbom-check, ci.yml, gates.yml, verify_gates_fail.sh)

branches.effect: stderr stale, return 1; else print match, return 0
